svg.title: Ruby SDK: Tier 3 to Tier 1
svg.desc: Ruby SDK results at its three tier assessments in 2026, drawn as a rough stone, a cut stone and a polished ruby. Server conformance went from 25 of 30 to 67 of 67, client conformance from not tested to 50 of 50, and documented features from 22 to 46 of 48.
